item.title: Fake Tantrik Arrested After Duping Woman of Gold in Guwahati
item.description: GUWAHATI: Basistha police Monday, February 23, arrested a self-styled “tantrik” for allegedly duping a woman in Sankardev Nagar. The accused, Faruk Ojha, reportedly conducted a fake puja on February 11 and stole her gold ornaments. item.title: Air Ambulance with 7 People on Board Crashes in Jharkhand's Chatra
item.description: GUWAHATI: An air ambulance carrying seven people crashed in Jharkhand’s Chatra district on Monday, February 23, while operating a medical evacuation flight from Ranchi to Delhi, officials said. item.title: 7th Kaziranga Waterbird Count Records 105,540 Birds; Rare Smew Makes First-Ever Appearance
item.description: GUWAHATI: Kaziranga National Park, the UNESCO World Heritage Site located in Assam, has once again reaffirmed its ecological significance globally with the release of the 7th Kaziranga Waterbird Count 2026 report. The census recorded an impressive 105,540 individual waterbirds representing 107 species, marking one of the highest tallies since the initiative began.
